questions: When the board is fully visible, does it hold exactly three pens arranged in a single row?
Are all three pens aligned identically, all pointing the same way, including any pen near the left or right frame edge as it enters or exits?
Do all three pens share identical barrel and cap colors, with no mismatch?
Is every pen fully capped with no exposed writing tip, and are all three pens equal in length?
Does the board advance steadily from left to right at EVERY moment, never halting, freezing, or pausing even briefly (1-3 seconds) at any point in the video?
Do all pens stay fixed in their positions on the board, with no pen shifting, sliding, or moving on its own relative to the board mid-clip?

question_answers.evidence: When the board is fully in view (around 00:08-00:10), there are clearly three pens arranged in a row.
The middle pen is oriented with its writing tip pointing downwards, while the left and right pens have their caps pointing downwards. They are not all aligned the same way.
All three pens appear to have the same dark/black barrel and cap color.
The middle pen shows a bare, pointed writing tip at the bottom, whereas the other two pens have caps covering the tip at the bottom. The middle pen appears to be uncapped.
The board moves smoothly from left to right throughout the clip without stopping or jamming.
The pens remain fixed in their positions relative to the board as it moves.

parsed.reason: The middle pen is uncapped, showing a bare writing tip at the bottom, while the other two pens are capped at the bottom. This violates the condition that every pen must be complete and capped.
